text: DSH Settings Sidebar 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 和 Desktop 的侧栏管理插件。它在侧栏和设置页面提供菜单管理界面，让用户搜索并切换原有面板的显示状态，也能为没有侧栏入口的设置分区添加快捷入口。用户可以从列表跳转到面板或对应设置，偏好保存在当前客户端。适合希望精简导航并快速打开常用设置的 DSH 用户；不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Settings Sidebar helps DeepSeek Harness users manage sidebar navigation. Search entries, show or hide panels, and add shortcuts to Settings sections. Visibility choices stay in this client; no API key or external service is needed.
想把不常用的 DSH 侧栏入口隐藏起来。
能不能从侧边栏直接打开常用的设置分区？
I want to customize which panels appear in my DSH sidebar.
DSH Settings Sidebar 的功能「侧栏菜单显隐」：在管理页面搜索侧栏菜单并切换显示状态，选择会保存在当前客户端，并即时更新导航显示。
DSH Settings Sidebar 的功能「设置快捷入口」：为没有原生侧栏面板的设置分区添加侧栏入口，点击后打开对应设置；可从管理页跳转，且注册会随可见状态更新。
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 8；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Sidebar menus for DeepSeek Harness：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

Show or hide sidebar panel entries and add shortcuts to Settings sections. Existing panels use their actual sidebar names, not the shorter names of their corresponding Settings sections.
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Settings shortcuts in the sidebar：Screenshots show two example configurations. Captured and provided by the plugin author for publication.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness Web or Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1`) with the sidebar, Settings and layout client APIs. The Harness refuses to install the plugin where the running version does not satisfy that range. The plugin ships directly loadable JavaScript: no build, install scripts or additional runtime dependencies. React and the client store are supplied by the Harness module loader.

Ask your Harness agent:

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Install：> Install the GitHub plugin github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar

Or install into your active CLI profile (`desktop` below is the Desktop profile; substitute your own):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar
```

Alternatively, download `dsh-settings-sidebar.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar/releases) and run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-settings-sidebar.tgz
```

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Install：For a pinned version, use `github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar#v1.4.0`. The package keeps its internal identifier `@local/dsh-settings-sidebar`; it is distributed through GitHub/tarballs, not npm.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Use：Where a menu opens depends on whether its content has a main page. Entries with their own main-content page open that page in the main content area, exactly as the original sidebar button does; entries that exist only as a Settings section have no main page, so they open the Settings dialog already positioned on that section. Such a dialog does not replace the page you were on: closing it leaves that page selected, and if that page's plugin has been removed the shortcut falls back to the conversation. The Plugins inventory page and the built-in-plugin Settings section are separate entries.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Use：Hiding an entry does not disable its plugin, delete its page or remove its Settings entry. New Session, workspace browsing and account/Settings controls are outside the panel-menu scope; Settings remains available for recovery.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Data and safety：Visibility choices stay in this client's `localStorage`. No network requests, account/model/Host configuration changes, session-data changes or model tools are added. Preferences do not sync between clients. First-version pins are migrated; failed saves report an error and preserve the current state. Uninstalling removes policy styles and added shortcuts, restoring original panels. Local preferences remain for reinstalls.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Compatibility and limitations：The current host has no public filter for every original sidebar panel. Original entries are hidden by a stylesheet rendered in `shell.overlay`, scoped to the global navigation and complete button accessibility names. Labels are CSS-string escaped and follow locale changes. The plugin does not read or rewrite other plugins' DOM or replace the sidebar. New Settings shortcuts use ordinary slot registrations and disposers.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Compatibility and limitations：- Hiding affects sidebar navigation rows only. More's popup or other locations may still expose the same function.
- Two original entries with exactly the same display name are hidden together.
- The plugin depends on current navigation markup, `layout.panelInfo` subscription and the Settings shell's shared Store `openSection` action. Host upgrades require revalidation. Settings navigation failures are reported in the manager.
- Existing panels default to visible; Settings shortcuts without an existing sidebar entry default to hidden.
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Compatibility and limitations：The SVG icon is original artwork; the storefront PNG is converted from it. No third-party UI artwork is bundled.

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · Development and verification：```sh
npm test
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

Node's built-in tests cover names, original/self visibility, shortcut lifecycle, persistence/migration, failed storage, preserved modal backgrounds and listener disposal. Installed Desktop checks also exercised original-panel hiding, manager recovery through Settings and closing Models Settings back onto the Plugins page. These checks are not a cross-version compatibility guarantee.

控制 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏功能菜单的显示，并为设置页面添加快捷入口。菜单名称采用侧边栏实际显示的名称，而不是对应设置项的简称。
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 设置快捷入口显示在侧栏：两张截图展示不同的配置示例，由插件作者截取并提供用于公开介绍。
section: 设置快捷入口显示在侧栏

text:
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness Web 或 Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 或更新版本（`engines.dsh: >=0.2.2-rc.1`），并提供侧栏、设置和布局客户端接口。低于该版本时 Harness 会拒绝安装。插件使用可直接加载的 JavaScript，无需构建、额外运行时依赖或安装脚本。React 和客户端 Store 由 Harness 的模块加载器提供。

在 Harness 对话中请求安装：

> 安装 GitHub 插件 github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar

或在 CLI 安装到所用 profile（下面以 Desktop 的 `desktop` 为例，其他 profile 请替换名称）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar
```

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 安装：也可从 [Releases](https://github.com/zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar/releases) 下载安装包后安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-settings-sidebar.tgz
```

使用固定版本时将 GitHub spec 改为 `github:zyileven/dsh-settings-sidebar#v1.4.0`。本包保留内部标识 `@local/dsh-settings-sidebar`，仅从 GitHub/安装包分发，不发布到 npm。

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 使用：1. 从侧栏或“设置 → 侧栏菜单管理”打开管理页。
2. 搜索菜单并切换开关，立即显示或隐藏。侧栏原有功能菜单、更多及管理插件自身均可控制。
3. 隐藏管理插件自身后，从设置中的同名菜单重新开启。

点击后的去向取决于该菜单是否有主界面内容页：自身有内容页的菜单在主界面内容区域打开该页面，和原侧栏按钮完全一致；只存在于设置里的菜单没有主界面页面，则直接打开设置弹窗并定位到对应菜单项。这种弹窗不会顶掉你当前所在的页面，关闭后仍停留在原页面；若原页面所属插件已卸载，则返回当前会话。“插件”库存页与“内置插件”设置是两个不同入口。

关闭入口不会停用插件、删除页面或隐藏设置弹窗里的菜单。新建会话、工作区浏览、账号/设置按钮是应用操作区，不在控制范围内；保留设置按钮以便恢复隐藏项。
@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 数据与安全：只在当前客户端的 `localStorage` 保存菜单显隐，不修改账户、模型、Host 配置或会话数据，不发送网络请求，不添加模型工具。设置不会同步到其他浏览器。升级读取第一版已固定菜单；存储失败显示错误并保持原状态。卸载移除样式和新增快捷入口，恢复原生菜单；本地偏好保留供重新安装使用。

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 兼容性与限制：当前宿主没有过滤全部原生侧栏菜单的公开接口。因此原生菜单通过 `shell.overlay` 中的样式按全局导航和按钮完整无障碍名称隐藏，不读取或改写其他插件的 DOM、不替换侧栏。名称按 CSS 字符串转义，语言变化时更新。新增设置快捷入口通过普通插槽注册与释放。

- 隐藏只影响侧栏导航行；“更多”弹出菜单或其他位置仍可能提供原功能。
- 两个原生入口名称完全相同时，按名称匹配会一起隐藏。
- 依赖当前宿主导航标记、`layout.panelInfo` 订阅和设置壳共享 Store 的 `openSection` 动作。宿主升级后需重新验证；无法打开设置时显示错误。
- 默认保留原有菜单；没有原生侧栏入口的设置快捷项默认关闭。

SVG 图标为本插件原创，市场 PNG 由该图标转换。界面未包含第三方图片。

@local/dsh-settings-sidebar README · 开发与验证：```sh
npm test
npm pack --ignore-scripts
```

测试使用 Node 内置测试运行器，覆盖名称、原生与自身入口开关、快捷入口生命周期、持久化与迁移、存储错误、弹窗背景保留和订阅释放。另在已安装的 Desktop 中实测过原生菜单隐藏、从设置恢复管理入口，以及关闭模型设置后仍停留在插件页。测试不等于跨版本兼容保证。
